historyNote104: Records for this operator on this device, including other shifts. Fiscal documents and bank confirmations are separate.
pageFilter104: Filters and CSV cover only the loaded page. Use a reference to look up a sale directly.
suspendNote104: Review items and loaded prices before resuming. The server still checks the final confirmation.
missing104: Product or unit is missing from this screen’s catalog. Refresh the catalog before resuming.
review104: I reviewed price changes for this cart
cartBusy104: Complete or suspend the current sale before resuming another.
notSale104: A suspended cart is not a sale or payment and does not reserve stock.
sourceError104: Unable to load the record. Check connection, reference and permission.
invalid104: Unable to validate the received data.
